_instructions: This file is the persistent manual curation store.
Add entries here to inject items into the dashboard that automated fetchers may miss.
Entries survive pipeline refreshes — they are NEVER overwritten by automated runs.
Fields marked REQUIRED must be present. All others are optional.
ENTRY TYPES AND REQUIRED FIELDS:
trial       — nct_id (REQUIRED), company (REQUIRED)
publication — doi or pmid (at least one REQUIRED), company (REQUIRED)
news        — url (REQUIRED), title (REQUIRED), company (REQUIRED)
HOW LIVE RE-FETCH WORKS:
Trials with nct_id: re-fetched weekly from ClinicalTrials.gov v2 API.
Publications with pmid: re-fetched weekly from PubMed.
Publications with doi only (no pmid): NOT re-fetched (static snapshot).
News/funding with url: NOT re-fetched (news articles don't update in place).
DASHBOARD DISPLAY:
All curated entries appear in their respective tabs with a 📌 Pinned badge.
They are also visible in the company slide-out panel under the relevant section.
TO ADD AN ENTRY:
1. Copy the appropriate template from the examples below.
2. Fill in the required fields.
3. Set 'data' to null — fetch_curated.py will populate it on the next run.
4. Commit to GitHub. Trigger a manual pipeline run if you want it immediately.
